extracted.name: Lemon Panko-Crusted Salmon
extracted.description: Seasoned panko on salmon bakes up into a crispy, crunchy crust that adds excellent flavor and texture to this simple recipe for tender, flaky salmon.
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C). Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil.
Combine panko, Parmesan, lemon-pepper seasoning, thyme, parsley, garlic, and lemon zest in a bowl.
Place salmon onto the prepared baking sheet. Brush melted butter over top, then sprinkle with panko mixture.
Bake in the preheated oven until fish flakes easily with a fork, 20 to 25 minutes.
